 Watch this capture in the Wireshark on your computer

 Run this command in a terminal on your computer, not in this one.
 It is on your clipboard already, y copies it again:

   ssh demo@192.0.2.10 'containerlab capture --name dc1 --target leaf1:e1-49 --target spine1:e1-1 -w -'
   | wireshark -k -i -

 The capture runs for as long as that Wireshark stays open.

 The address in the command is the one your SSH session came in on. Use the name or address you normally reach this
 host with, should it differ.
